question: A person buys a book for ₹ 300 and sells it for ₹ 335. What will be his profit percentage?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Profit = SP − CP = 335 − 300 = ₹35

Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100

Profit % = (35 ÷ 300) × 100 = 35 ÷ 3 = 11(2)/(3)% 

**∴ The correct answer is 11(2)/(3)% **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Cost Price (CP) of the book = ₹300

Selling Price (SP) of the book = ₹335

**Formula Used:**

Profit = SP − CP

Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP)
